validity.researcher_notes: Both harvested citations were opened directly (2 of 2 in the pool for this page). https://petro-news.com/11234/ (Arabic, petro-news.com, dated 12 Aug 2021, a PPC company-profile article covering multiple PPC products lines) explicitly names this exact route and spec: 'مشروع إنشاء خط من مسطرد / طنطا قطر 16 بوصة منتجات بطول 110 كيلو متر' (a line from Musturad/Tanta, 16-inch diameter, products, 110 km length) built to move turbine fuel from the Musturad refining company via Tanta to Alexandria port for export. This matches GEM's LengthKnown=110 km and Diameter=16 in EXACTLY. Independently, https://www.alamaltaqa.com/9875 (Arabic, alamaltaqa.com, dated 14 Nov 2019) reports PPC's chairman confirming restoration of 'خط المنتجات البترولية مسطرد - طنطا - الأسكندرية' (the Musturad-Tanta-Alexandria petroleum products line) after a theft-related benzene leak at Itay al-Barud, Beheira -- i.e. an ALREADY-OPERATING line under this name existed by Nov 2019, run at full capacity after repair ('عاد للعمل بكامل طاقته'). Two independent Arabic outlets, two years apart, both naming a Musturad-Tanta(-Alexandria) petroleum-products transmission line run by PPC/EGPC: existence is well supported. Verdict: confirmed, not a phantom/GEM-only entity. CAVEAT worth flagging: the two sources are not perfectly congruent. The spec-matching source (petro-news, Aug 2021) frames the 16in/110km line as 'مشروع إنشاء' (a construction project) -- in isolation that phrasing would read as still-under-construction in 2021, which would conflict with GEM's Status=operating (last touched 2026-02-17). But the OTHER source (alamaltaqa, Nov 2019, predating the 'project' article by ~21 months) already describes an operating Musturad-Tanta-Alexandria line being repaired and run at full capacity -- so a facility under that name predates the 2021 'project' framing, which is more consistent with company-profile Arabic usage that lists 'مشروع' for a company's built/established assets (the same article structures OTHER already-operating PPC lines, e.g. Suez/Musturad since 1955, the same way) than with the line still being unbuilt as of 2021. On balance this favors Status=operating being correct, but neither source gives a start year or an explicit post-2019 statement that the SPECIFIC 16in/110km segment (vs. an older/different-spec predecessor on the same general corridor) is complete and running. WebSearch quota was exhausted for this session (200/200) before a fresh 2022+ confirmation could be found; DuckDuckGo/Bing/Google were also tried via WebFetch and returned unusable/CAPTCHA'd results, so this could not be chased further this pass. Recommend a future pass re-check Status with a fresh search budget. Separately: gem.wiki's own cached snapshot of this page shows Diameter='12 in', which does NOT match the current sheet value of 16in or the cited source (which says 16-inch) -- the WIKI page is stale, not the sheet; no sheet fix needed, flagging only so a future wiki resync doesn't silently 'correct' the sheet's already-right value back to the wiki's stale one. Also note: both sources describe the physical corridor as continuing Tanta->Alexandria, while GEM's row endpoints stop at Tanta -- possibly GEM tracks only a segment of a longer corridor and a Tanta-Alexandria continuation may be a Discovery candidate, but that is a country-level Discovery question, out of scope for this row-level audit and not actioned here.
